title: TrailRenderer
cue: ribbon trails: sword swings, tracers, speed streaks
summary: Ribbon trails and lines built as meshes: a TrailRenderer leaves a fading ribbon behind whatever moves, and a LineRenderer draws a ribbon through points set from code.
useWhen: Motion should leave a mark: sword and claw swings, bullet tracers, missile smoke, speed streaks behind cars and dashes, magic ribbons, lightning, lasers, and ropes drawn as ribbons. Particle trails draw nothing in Web builds; these do.
avoidWhen: A puff of particles or a stretched sprite is enough, or the game is 2D, where Line2D does this.
